description: Defines models, enums, constants, and default settings for value card widgets in the Thingsboard UI, including layout options, styling, and configuration interfaces.

methods.name: valueCardLayouts
methods.description: Returns an array of layout options based on whether the layout is horizontal or not.

methods.name: valueCardDefaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default configuration settings for a value card widget, parameterized by layout orientation.
